name: Scrying Chambers
description: A vaulted hall of still water and lenses. The guild's divination organ: it charts what lies ahead before the party ever sets out: sites, objectives, and the patrols that hunt them.

tiers.description: The lenses find the nearest hidden sites. At the start of each expedition, the 2 nearest undiscovered points of interest are charted as beacons.
Sight enough to fix the goal itself. Charts one further site (3 total), and reveals the run objective's location, charting the ground around it. No more wandering blind toward the destination.
Foresight sharp enough to read intent. Charts a fourth site (4 total), and once per expedition the party foresees and slips the first ambush, and the patrol passes without forcing combat.
